n: Multifunction Over-the-range Oven With Flush Built-in Design
desc: This KitchenAid® Multifunction Over-the-Range Oven combines the versatility of an air fryer, toaster oven, convection oven, microwave and ventilation hood, all in one space-saving appliance designed for flush installation within a standard 12 ¾" cutout.
hl: Replaces a countertop air fryer for all of the crisping with none of the clutter.
Uses the power of steam to help loosen cooked-on food without the need for harsh cleaners.
Two LED Lights with Night Light Setting
Provide two levels of brightness, allowing you to illuminate the entire cooking surface below with natural-looking light or subtly accent the kitchen with a soft, inviting glow.
Conceal aluminum mesh filters behind a sleek stainless steel panel for a fully finished look.
Comfortably fits a variety of dishes with enough height for a mixing bowl and width for a 9" x 13" casserole dish or multiple items at the same time.
Replace a convection or toaster oven, freeing up counter space by elevating your baking, roasting, broiling and toasting.
